inputs.name: registerNewCommand.program
inputs.description: Registers app, game and lib commands. Apps support --adapter auto or static. Games support --engine sveltekit or godot and --dimension 2d or 3d.

outputs.name: registerNewCommand
outputs.description: The function returns nothing; its effect is to register the 'new' command, with app, game and lib subcommands that each have an action handler, on the program. The handlers are attached here and are not called by this function.

errors.name: runCreateProject
errors.description: Each app, game and lib action returns the promise from runCreateProject, which has no try/catch, so it rejects with whatever createProject(...) or renderCreateProject(result) throws. new.ts does not define or narrow those errors.
